title: NBN POI 2TAM (Tamworth) - Permanent repair due to rodent damage
current_summary: Scheduled maintenance on the network backhaul serving NBN POI 2TAM (Tamworth) has been completed. All maintenance work was carried out between 11:00 PM on 17 September and 6:00 AM on 18 September (AEST). Services have returned to normal, and no further interruption is expected.

updates.content: We will be performing planned repair work on the network backhaul that serves NBN POI 2TAM (Tamworth). The maintenance window is from 11:00 PM on 3 September to 6:00 AM on 4 September (AEST). During this time, some NBN services in the Tamworth area may experience brief interruptions or slower speeds for up to 6 hours within the window. Our team will monitor closely and work with our network partners to minimise impact and restore normal service as quickly as possible. No action is required from you.

The planned maintenance for NBN POI 2TAM (Tamworth) has been rescheduled. The new maintenance window will be from 11:00 PM on 17 September to 6:00 AM on 18 September (AEST). Please note that NBN services may be interrupted or experience slower speeds for up to 6 hours within this period. No action is required from you.

The previously advised maintenance window for NBN POI 2TAM (Tamworth) remains unchanged. Maintenance is scheduled to occur from 11:00 PM on 17 September to 6:00 AM on 18 September (AEST). No further changes have been announced.

The planned maintenance for NBN POI 2TAM (Tamworth) has been completed. All work was finished within the scheduled window from 11:00 PM on 17 September to 6:00 AM on 18 September (AEST). Services have returned to normal and no further disruptions are expected.
